verdicts.quote: Rejection or a confirmed creation failure creates zero users from this attempt. ... Keep publication whole. Positive: The complete creation set becomes authoritative before success can be reported.
An invalid field or missing required value rejects the entire file and identifies the affected CSV record and, where identifiable, its column and the reason.
An identity collision within the file or with an existing account rejects the full attempt without modifying the conflicting account.
CSV fields cannot select a target or bypass the assigned permissions of ordinary user creation.
verdicts.missing: Whether the file may name roles at all and, if so, how each named role is checked against the importer's own authority rather than ordinary defaults.

verdicts.quote: An admin with create authority in the selected user-management scope can open the import and select a CSV.
verdicts.missing: The spec ties import to ordinary create authority and leaves the admin grant open; it does not state that import is a distinct permission not implied by single-user creation.

verdicts.quote: Invalid encoding, malformed quoting, missing or duplicate headers, unsupported headers, and data records with the wrong field count reject the file with actionable feedback; no user is created.
UTF-8 with an optional initial byte-order mark, comma-delimited fields, one header record, CRLF or LF record separators ... Double-quoted fields can contain commas, line breaks or doubled quotes

Open prerequisite for the product owner: determine ... any required invitations, activation, credentials, notifications or audit effects. Open feasibility prerequisite ...: verify whole-batch publication, including any mandatory provisioning effects
verdicts.missing: What happens to invitations or other side effects already triggered for earlier rows when a later row fails; whether they are deferred until commit or undone.

verdicts.quote: Input above the effective byte ceiling is rejected with a size-limit outcome, zero creations and a way to choose a smaller file.
verdicts.missing: The actual byte ceiling and any row cap value; both are left open.

verdicts.quote: Empty input, header-only input and data made up entirely of empty records produce a no-data error. ... A single valid data row is enough for an import.
A repeat of a successful file while those identities still exist fails with conflicts and creates no duplicates.
After submission the view indicates processing ... On lost confirmation the view states that the result is unknown and directs the admin to check the authoritative user list
verdicts.missing: Whether large files run in the background and how the admin is told of completion after leaving the view; processing duration and disconnect behavior are left to revalidation.

verdicts.quote: determine the canonical identity, uniqueness scope, account defaults and any required invitations, activation, credentials, notifications or audit effects.
verdicts.missing: Whether invitation/welcome mail is sent for imported users and how bulk sends are paced.

verdicts.quote: Created accounts use the ordinary user lifecycle. Open prerequisite for the product owner: determine ... account defaults and any required invitations, activation, credentials
verdicts.missing: Whether created users are active or pending, whether they have a password, and how they first sign in.

verdicts.quote: Discard temporary processing data when the operation settles or is terminated ... No durable raw upload, import history or cross-client drafts are required.
The domain contract must supply allowed headers and matching rules, required/optional fields, normalization, valid field values and handling of omitted optional values.
verdicts.missing: Date, number and locale formats for field values are not addressed; normalization is deferred to an unspecified domain contract.

verdicts.quote: Existing mandatory account auditing, if applicable, follows its authoritative policy ... using sanitized attempt references and outcome categories.
verdicts.missing: Whether an audit record of who imported which file and when is required, and what it contains.

verdicts.quote: A disconnected or superseded view cannot control a submitted operation.
verdicts.missing: Whether an admin can cancel a running import; retrying only failed rows is not addressed beyond correcting and resubmitting the whole file.

verdicts.quote: At the effective input envelope, the surface shows processing and remains responsive ... No SLA or numeric performance target is established.
verdicts.missing: A time bound for a maximum-size file and progress indication beyond a generic processing state.

verdicts.quote: Preserve any applicable account-creation and target-access rules ... Existing users are preserved.
